content: react-native-mmkv 4.3.2 (2026-06) is a Nitro Module: requires react-native-nitro-modules (peer, install via npx expo install react-native-mmkv react-native-nitro-modules), RN >=0.76. Config plugin REMOVED in v4 (no app.plugin.js in tarball; old react-native-mmkv/plugin entry is obsolete). Encrypted instance: createMMKV({ encryptionKey, encryptionType: 'AES-256' }) - AES-128 is default, must specify AES-256. JSI-based: no remote Chrome debugging.
